functions.name: create_lead
functions.description: Creates a new sales lead in the PosterBooking CRM. Call this function when you have collected business information from the prospect during the call.

business_name.description: The name of the prospect's business

contact_name.description: The full name of the person you are speaking with

industry.description: The industry the business operates in (e.g., Retail, Hospitality, Healthcare)

number_of_locations.description: How many physical locations the business has

estimated_screens.description: Estimated number of digital screens the business would need

current_solution.description: What the business currently uses for signage or promotions

interest_level.description: How interested the prospect seems. Hot = very interested, Warm = somewhat interested, Cold = not very interested

notes.description: Any additional notes or context from the conversation

functions.name: send_email
functions.description: Sends an email to the prospect. Use 'signup' template to send a signup link, 'follow_up' for follow-up emails, and 'demo' for demo invitations.

lead_id.description: The lead ID returned from create_lead. Associate this email with the lead.

template.description: Which email template to send. Use 'signup' for new prospects, 'follow_up' for reconnecting, 'demo' for demo scheduling.

functions.name: send_sms
functions.description: Sends an SMS message to the prospect's phone number.

lead_id.description: The lead ID to associate this SMS with

phone.description: The recipient's phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +14155551234)

message.description: The SMS message to send (max 1600 characters)

functions.name: save_call_summary
functions.description: Saves the call summary after the conversation ends. Include the transcript, summary, duration, and outcome.

lead_id.description: The lead ID to associate this call with

retell_call_id.description: The Retell call ID for this call

summary.description: Brief summary of the call outcome and key points discussed

functions.name: get_company
functions.description: Retrieves company information including website, signup URL, support email, and knowledge base URL. Use this to answer prospect questions about PosterBooking.

functions.name: health_check
functions.description: Checks if the backend API is running and healthy.
